scope: targeted scan, not exhaustive SOTA certification

papers.title: From Data Imputation to Data Cleaning — Automated Cleaning of Tabular Data Improves Downstream Predictive Performance
papers.verification_scope: Primary proceedings page checked; methods full-text still to audit
papers.relation_to_idea3: Closest task baseline: imputation plus conformal calibration. Replacing the imputer with a TFM alone is a weak contribution.

papers.title: ZeroED: Hybrid Zero-shot Error Detection through Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.relation_to_idea3: LLM reasoning generates/propagates pseudo-labels and trains a detector. Compare same row universe, label availability and token budget; zero-shot is not training-free.

papers.title: Ensembling LLM-Induced Decision Trees for Explainable and Robust Error Detection
papers.verification_scope: arXiv metadata/abstract and HTML inspected; acceptance not established
papers.relation_to_idea3: TreeED/ForestED uses LLM-induced trees and ensembles. Important newer direct-task baseline beyond ZeroED; audit sampled-versus-full-table protocols before importing scores.

papers.title: Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model
papers.verification_scope: Publisher search extracts and official repository checked; full publisher page access limited
papers.relation_to_idea3: Already includes density estimation and anomaly detection abilities. A claim of first using TFM for anomalies is untenable; inspect its conditional/joint construction.

papers.title: TabPFN unsupervised extension (implementation)
papers.relation_to_idea3: Inspect conditional feature scoring and feature-order aggregation before defining a new masked likelihood method. Pin a commit and API; row scores do not establish cell localization.

papers.title: TACTIC for Navigating the Unknown: Tabular Anomaly deteCTion via In-Context inference
papers.verification_scope: arXiv abstract and HTML checked; acceptance not established
papers.relation_to_idea3: Explicitly studies instability of unsupervised TabPFN with noisy/contaminated context and computational cost. Contamination as a broad failure mode is already studied.

papers.title: Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection
papers.task: row anomaly / clean and contaminated reference
papers.verification_scope: arXiv metadata and HTML sections 2.1–2.3 inspected
papers.relation_to_idea3: ZEN uses frozen representations and nearest-neighbor scoring; FOCUS adapts weights. Section 2.1 includes leave-one-fold-out reference embeddings. Neither cross-fitting nor training-free PFN anomaly scoring is novel by itself.

papers.title: TaskBridge: Bridging Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection and In-Context Learning via Virtual Tasks
papers.verification_scope: arXiv metadata and HTML sections 3–4 inspected; code not reproduced
papers.relation_to_idea3: Builds normality-anchored virtual tasks and selection around pretrained TFMs. Strong recent candidate in row anomaly literature; its benchmark ranking is paper-reported, not a cell-ED ranking.

papers.title: TICDA: Tabular In-Context Data Attribution
papers.verification_scope: arXiv metadata and HTML sections 2, 3.1–3.3 inspected
papers.relation_to_idea3: Influence from linear surrogates on embeddings supports labeling-error detection and context curation. Relevant to choosing/pruning context, but supervised target labels differ from arbitrary dirty table cells.

papers.title: Model-Aware Data Cleaning for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.verification_scope: Current v2 abstract and change note checked
papers.relation_to_idea3: RL chooses cleaning operators for downstream use. v2 corrects earlier prior-alignment framing; do not cite obsolete v1 claims as proven alignment.

papers.title: Noise Immunity in In-Context Tabular Learning: An Empirical Robustness Analysis of TabPFN's Attention Mechanisms
papers.verification_scope: arXiv metadata/abstract checked; full method audit pending
papers.relation_to_idea3: Controlled irrelevant/correlated features and noisy labels are not the same as heterogeneous cell-level errors. Useful mechanistic background, not a direct RAHA error detector.

papers.title: FoMo-0D: A Foundation Model for Zero-shot Tabular Outlier Detection
papers.relation_to_idea3: Anomaly-specific synthetic pretraining and zero-shot detection. Distinguish its clean-reference assumptions from unsupervised polluted-context settings.

papers.title: From Zero to Hero: Advancing Zero-Shot Foundation Models for Tabular Outlier Detection
papers.relation_to_idea3: OUTFORMER extends anomaly-specific pretraining with mixed priors/curriculum. A newer comparator to FoMo-0D if a row-level experiment is added.

papers.title: TabICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for In-Context Learning on Large Data
papers.verification_scope: arXiv metadata and official repo checked
papers.relation_to_idea3: Original TabICL is classification-only. Current repository also offers v2 regression; that is a separate checkpoint capability and should not be silently attributed to v1.

papers.title: Detecting Deviating Data Cells
papers.verification_scope: Publisher primary metadata/abstract and author manuscript link found
papers.relation_to_idea3: Classical cellwise prediction using cross-variable dependence. Numeric-only baseline can reveal whether TFM gains exceed robust correlation-based detection.

papers.title: The Cellwise Minimum Covariance Determinant Estimator
papers.verification_scope: Publisher primary abstract and author manuscript found
papers.relation_to_idea3: Cellwise robust likelihood/penalty formulation. Useful classical reference; mixed-type semantic errors remain a separate scope.

papers.title: Single-Pass Conformal Cross-Modal Anomaly Screening with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.verification_scope: Official author repo read; OpenReview browser challenge blocked paper verification
papers.relation_to_idea3: Very close implementation lead: feature-from-others reconstruction and leave-one-out calibration. Do not treat repository headline results or venue/date as independently verified paper evidence.

papers.title: Contextual Learning for Anomaly Detection in Tabular Data
papers.verification_scope: arXiv primary record/abstract checked after live CLI discovery
papers.relation_to_idea3: Models conditional normality for heterogeneous contexts. Relevant to rare-valid behavior in brainstorming; it is not a PFN/TabICL method and should not be conflated with ICLAD.

papers.title: Anomaly Detection of Tabular Data Using LLMs
papers.record_date_or_venue: 2024 / workshop acceptance reported in arXiv record
papers.verification_scope: arXiv primary record/abstract checked after live CLI discovery
papers.relation_to_idea3: Studies pretrained LLM anomaly detection and optional fine-tuning on synthetic tasks. Contextual background for a semantic detector; not a direct heterogeneous-cell F1 baseline.
